prompt: You recently borrowed a camera from a friend for a photography class. Unfortunately, you accidentally dropped it, and now the lens is cracked and the camera won't turn on. Your friend needs it back for an urgent project this weekend.
choices: Call your friend. Explain what happened to the camera and offer a solution.
Call the camera shop. Explain the situation and ask for repair options.
samples:
Hi Sarah, I'm calling about your camera. I have some really bad news and I am so sorry. I was using it for my class project, and I accidentally dropped it. The lens is cracked and it won't turn on anymore. I feel terrible about this.

I want to make this right immediately, especially because I know your project is this weekend. First, I've already found a professional camera store downtown that does urgent repairs. I am going to take it there first thing tomorrow morning and I will pay for everything. I know speed is important. Second, the shop also offers camera rentals. So, I will rent the exact same model for you to use this weekend. This way, your project won't be delayed at all. It's the least I can do. Finally, if the camera can't be fixed quickly, I will just buy you a brand-new one. Your project is important, and you should not be inconvenienced by my mistake.

Please let me know if this plan sounds okay. I will do whatever it takes to fix this situation for you. Again, I am really sorry.

Hello, I need some help with a damaged camera. I borrowed it from a friend, and I accidentally dropped it. Now the lens has a crack in it and the power isn't working. My friend needs it for an urgent project this weekend.

I'm hoping you can tell me what my options are. First, could you tell me if a repair like this is possible? I want to know if the damage sounds too serious to fix. Second, I need to know how quickly you could complete the repair. Because my friend needs it by Saturday, I'm looking for the fastest possible service. I would be willing to pay extra for a rush job if that is an option. Finally, I need an estimate of the cost. I will be paying for the repair myself, so a price range would be very helpful. If a repair isn't practical or fast enough, do you happen to rent out similar camera models? That might be another way I can solve my friend's problem in time for her project.

I can bring the camera into your shop anytime tomorrow. Thank you for your help.
